What, no HOT setups? You gotta be kidding me. Not one in the entire universe today. This is the kind of environment where traders start complaining there’s “nothing to do,” but let me tell you something—**the absence of action is, in itself, a signal**. When the scoreboard comes up blank, it’s not time to panic; it’s time to listen because the market is whispering something important.

Here’s the deal: 0 HOT setups and 0 on WARM? That screams of indecision. It’s like the market just took its foot off the gas and parked it in neutral, waiting to see what happens next. Risk is muted across the board, but if you’re watching the data, you’ll notice buyers aren’t exactly heading for the exits either. Breadth is flat, volatility is subdued, and every sector chart I look at is as noncommittal as a teenager deciding what to eat for dinner. That tells me we’re poised for a break in either direction—so this is prime time to get your watchlists tight and your game plan tighter.

Now, let’s talk rotations. When you scan our portfolio, what jumps out? For me, it’s got to be the Uranium/Nuclear plays—$UUUU, $NNE, $SMR, $UEC. These guys are sneaky strong. Look at $UUUU, up 133% since entry, and we’ve already bagged profits on half the position. That’s leadership. And it’s not just this one name; the entire nuclear space has this quiet undercurrent of strength. The market is telling us something. Are we listening? With the global trend towards clean energy and nuclear coming back into fashion, the stars are aligning for a potential next leg higher. I'm not saying back up the truck here, but keep watching these names. If we get one more catalyst—oil prices spiking, uranium contract news—this group could catch fire.

On the crypto side, $ETHA and $BLSH continue to be studs in the portfolio, feeding off Bitcoin’s recent resilience. Sure, BTC isn’t setting new highs, but it’s stopped selling off, and that’s step one in any recovery. Throw in the fact that we’re also seeing faint signs of life in $COIN (140% from entry!) and $SBET, and you’ve got to think spec money is sniffing around the digital space again. The bears? They’ve got nothing.

Portfolio-wise, late entries are tricky in this chop, but a few setups still look actionable. $AFRM hasn’t run away yet, and fintech remains a sleeper hit this year. And how about $RCAT in drones? Up 50% but feels like it wants more. No double-down alerts today, but keep an eye on Uranium names for reentry points if they give us a pullback.

What to watch today? Keep it simple. Watch oil, watch the 10-year yield, and for the love of all things technical, keep an eye on the $SPY 200-day moving average. It’s the ultimate cheat code in this market. If we break below it, risk goes off faster than a bad trade. If we hold? Game on. Full stop.
